svg.content:
<mxfile host="drawio-xml2png" version="1.0.0"> <diagram id="arch-cloud" name="クラウドアーキテクチャ構成図"> <mxGraphModel dx="1200" dy="800" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1169" pageHeight="827" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" />
<!-- Title Banner --> <mxCell id="title" value="<b style="font-size:18px">マイクロサービス & クラウド基盤アーキテクチャ</b><br><font color="#555555">Pure Node.js (.mjs) draw.io XML → PNG Generator Demo</font>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;arcSize=15;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="20" width="960" height="55" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Client Actors --> <mxCell id="user" value="<b>エンドユーザー</b><br>Web / Mobile" style="shape=umlActor;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="65" y="195" width="45" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- AWS VPC Group --> <mxCell id="vpc" value="AWS Production VPC (10.0.0.0/16)" style="points=[[0,0],[0.25,0],[0.5,0],[0.75,0],[1,0],[1,0.25],[1,0.5],[1,0.75],[1,1],[0.75,1],[0.5,1],[0.25,1],[0,1],[0,0.75],[0,0.5],[0,0.25]];outlineConnect=0;gradientColor=none;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;shape=mxgraph.aws4.group;grIcon=mxgraph.aws4.group_vpc;strokeColor=#248814;fillColor=#F2F8F0;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacingLeft=35;strokeWidth=2;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="180" y="95" width="555" height="450" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- API Gateway & Auth --> <mxCell id="apigw" value="<b>Amazon API Gateway</b>" style="outlineConnect=0;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.api_gateway;fillColor=#E7157B;strokeColor=#ffffff;" vertex="1" parent="vpc"> <mxGeometry x="35" y="105" width="64" height="64" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="auth_check" value="<b>認証・認可</b><br>JWT検証" style="rhombus;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;shadow=1;" vertex="1" parent="vpc"> <mxGeometry x="155" y="100" width="120" height="74" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Compute Swimlane inside VPC --> <mxCell id="compute_lane" value="アプリケーション層 (Swimlane)" style="swimlane;startSize=28;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;swimlaneFillColor=#ffffff;fontStyle=1;rounded=1;shadow=1;" vertex="1" parent="vpc"> <mxGeometry x="320" y="45" width="210" height="230" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="lambda" value="<b>AWS Lambda</b><br>注文処理" style="outlineConnect=0;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.lambda;fillColor=#ED7100;strokeColor=#ffffff;" vertex="1" parent="compute_lane"> <mxGeometry x="25" y="65" width="60" height="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="k8s_pod" value="<b>EKS Pod</b><br>決済連携" style="html=1;dashed=0;whitespace=wrap;fillColor=#2875E2;strokeColor=#ffffff;shape=mxgraph.kubernetes.icon2;prIcon=pod;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;" vertex="1" parent="compute_lane"> <mxGeometry x="125" y="67" width="56" height="56" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Data Layer inside VPC --> <mxCell id="rds" value="<b>Aurora PostgreSQL</b><br>Primary DB" style="shape=cylinder3;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;boundedLbl=1;backgroundOutline=1;size=12;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;shadow=1;" vertex="1" parent="vpc"> <mxGeometry x="280" y="320" width="130" height="85" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="dynamo" value="<b>DynamoDB</b><br>セッションストア" style="outlineConnect=0;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.dynamodb;fillColor=#C925D1;strokeColor=#ffffff;" vertex="1" parent="vpc"> <mxGeometry x="445" y="325" width="64" height="64" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="note1" value="<b>監査ログ</b><br>S3へ非同期転送" style="shape=note;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;backgroundOutline=1;size=14;fillColor=#ffffc0;strokeColor=#999900;" vertex="1" parent="vpc"> <mxGeometry x="45" y="325" width="120" height="75" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Schema Table on Right --> <mxCell id="orders_tbl" value="orders (テーブル定義)" style="shape=table;startSize=30;container=1;collapsible=0;childLayout=tableLayout;fixedRows=1;rowLines=1;fontStyle=1;align=center;resizeLast=1;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;swimlaneFillColor=#ffffff;shadow=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="775" y="95" width="245" height="165" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="r1" value="" style="shape=tableRow;horizontal=0;startSize=0;swimlaneHead=0;swimlaneBody=0;fillColor=none;collapsible=0;dropTarget=0;points=[[0,0.5],[1,0.5]];portConstraint=eastwest;top=0;left=0;right=0;bottom=1;" vertex="1" parent="orders_tbl"> <mxGeometry y="30" width="245" height="45" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c11" value="PK" style="shape=partialRectangle;connectable=0;fillColor=none;top=0;left=0;bottom=0;right=1;fontStyle=1;align=center;" vertex="1" parent="r1"> <mxGeometry width="45" height="45" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c12" value="order_id (UUID)" style="shape=partialRectangle;connectable=0;fillColor=none;top=0;left=0;bottom=0;right=0;align=left;spacingLeft=8;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="r1"> <mxGeometry x="45" width="200" height="45" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="r2" value="" style="shape=tableRow;horizontal=0;startSize=0;swimlaneHead=0;swimlaneBody=0;fillColor=none;collapsible=0;dropTarget=0;points=[[0,0.5],[1,0.5]];portConstraint=eastwest;top=0;left=0;right=0;bottom=1;" vertex="1" parent="orders_tbl"> <mxGeometry y="75" width="245" height="45" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c21" value="FK" style="shape=partialRectangle;connectable=0;fillColor=none;top=0;left=0;bottom=0;right=1;align=center;" vertex="1" parent="r2"> <mxGeometry width="45" height="45" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c22" value="customer_id (BIGINT)" style="shape=partialRectangle;connectable=0;fillColor=none;top=0;left=0;bottom=0;right=0;align=left;spacingLeft=8;" vertex="1" parent="r2"> <mxGeometry x="45" width="200" height="45" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="r3" value="" style="shape=tableRow;horizontal=0;startSize=0;swimlaneHead=0;swimlaneBody=0;fillColor=none;collapsible=0;dropTarget=0;points=[[0,0.5],[1,0.5]];portConstraint=eastwest;top=0;left=0;right=0;bottom=0;" vertex="1" parent="orders_tbl"> <mxGeometry y="120" width="245" height="45" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c31" value="" style="shape=partialRectangle;connectable=0;fillColor=none;top=0;left=0;bottom=0;right=1;align=center;" vertex="1" parent="r3"> <mxGeometry width="45" height="45" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c32" value="total_amount (NUMERIC)" style="shape=partialRectangle;connectable=0;fillColor=none;top=0;left=0;bottom=0;right=0;align=left;spacingLeft=8;" vertex="1" parent="r3"> <mxGeometry x="45" width="200" height="45" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- External Cloud box on Bottom Right --> <mxCell id="ext_cloud" value="<b>外部決済プロバイダ</b><br>Stripe / PayJP" style="ellipse;shape=cloud;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;shadow=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="795" y="340" width="205" height="115" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Edges --> <mxCell id="edge_user_gw" value="HTTPS" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=classic;strokeWidth=2;strokeColor=#0066CC;" edge="1" parent="1" source="user" target="apigw"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="edge_gw_auth" value="Verify" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=classic;strokeWidth=2;strokeColor=#333333;" edge="1" parent="vpc" source="apigw" target="auth_check"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="edge_auth_lambda" value="OK" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeWidth=2;strokeColor=#248814;" edge="1" parent="vpc" source="auth_check" target="lambda"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="edge_lambda_rds" value="SQL Write" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;endArrow=classic;strokeWidth=2;strokeColor=#82b366;" edge="1" parent="vpc" source="compute_lane" target="rds"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="edge_pod_dynamo" value="Get/Put" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;exitX=0.75;exitY=1;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;endArrow=classic;strokeWidth=2;strokeColor=#C925D1;" edge="1" parent="vpc" source="compute_lane" target="dynamo"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="edge_rds_note" value="Audit" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;dashed=1;html=1;endArrow=open;strokeWidth=1.5;strokeColor=#999900;" edge="1" parent="vpc" source="rds" target="note1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="edge_rds_tbl" value="スキーマ参照" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;dashed=1;html=1;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=0.5;entryY=1;endArrow=ERmany;startArrow=ERmandOne;strokeWidth=1.5;strokeColor=#9673a6;" edge="1" parent="1" source="rds" target="orders_tbl"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="525" y="520" /> <mxPoint x="755" y="520" /> <mxPoint x="755" y="280" /> <mxPoint x="897" y="280" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="edge_pod_ext" value="Webhook" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;exitX=1;exitY=0.5;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;endArrow=classic;strokeWidth=2;strokeColor=#d79b00;" edge="1" parent="1" source="compute_lane" target="ext_cloud"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
